description_en: Queries information about all root CA certificates and subordinate CA certificates
description_zh: 查询所有根CA证书和子CA证书的信息
kebab_example: aliyun cas describe-ca-certificate-list --current-page 1 --show-size 20 --identifier 1ee47e24-c51b-67cc-aa6b-1f7561cf9d9a --cert-type subRoot --ca-status issue --valid-status valid --issuer-type local --resource-group-id rg-ae0000004wia --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCACertificateList

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Settings: specify the desired page number. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of CA certificates per page in a paging query. Settings: specify the desired number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含CA证书的数量。默认值为20
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the CA certificate.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html to query the unique identifiers of all CA certificates
parameters.help_zh:
CA证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html查询所有CA证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The type of the CA. Valid values:

root: root CA.
subRoot: subordinate CA.
externalCa: externally imported CA
parameters.help_zh:
CA的类型 。取值：

root：根CA。
subRoot：子CA。
externalCa：外部导入的CA
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
The current status of the CA. Valid values:

issue: enabled.
forbidden: disabled.
revoke: revoked
parameters.help_zh:
当前的CA状态，取值：

issue：启用。
forbidden：禁用。
revoke：已吊销
parameters.name: ca_status

parameters.help_en:
The time-based validity status of the CA. Valid values:

valid: The CA is within its validity period.
notValid: The CA has expired
parameters.help_zh:
CA时间状态。取值：

valid：表示CA处于有效期内。
notValid：表示CA已过期
parameters.name: valid_status

parameters.help_en:
The issuing authority of the CA. Valid values:

local: private certificate.
iTrusChina: compliance CA.
external: externally imported
parameters.help_zh:
签发CA的机构。取值：

local：私有证书。
iTrusChina： 合规CA。
external：外部导入
parameters.name: issuer_type

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2716559.html接口获取
parameters.name: resource_group_id

CertificateList.description_en: The list of CA certificate details

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: CA证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm type of the CA certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm.
ECC: ECC algorithm.
SM2: SM2 (Chinese national cryptographic) algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
CA证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: CA证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the CA certificate. Valid values:

ROOT: root CA certificate.
SUB_ROOT: subordinate CA certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
CA证书的类型。取值：

ROOT：表示根CA证书。
SUB_ROOT：表示子CA证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name or abbreviation of the organization associated with the CA certificate
CommonName.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构的通用名称或简称

CountryCode.description_en:
The country code of the organization associated with the CA certificate.

For more information about country codes, see the International codes section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

Gift.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a complimentary instance. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
Gift.description_zh:
是否为赠送实例。取值：

0：表示否。
1：表示是

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the CA certificate

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the CA certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the CA certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization associated with the CA certificate
Organization.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department within the organization associated with the CA certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en:
The unique identifier of the root CA certificate that issued this CA certificate.

This parameter is returned only when CertificateType is SUB_ROOT (subordinate CA certificate)
ParentIdentifier.description_zh:
签发该CA证书的根CA证书的唯一识别码。

只有当CertificateType为SUB_ROOT（表示子CA证书）时，才会返回该参数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

Sans.description_en: The Subject Alternative Names (SANs) of the certificate

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the CA certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the CA certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the CA certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the CA certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued normally.
REVOKE: The certificate has been revoked
Status.description_zh:
CA证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The Distinguished Name (DN) attribute of the CA certificate, which represents the subject of the certificate. It contains the following information:

C: The country code of the organization.
O: The name of the organization.
OU: The department within the organization.
L: The city where the organization is located.
CN: The common name or abbreviation of the organization
SubjectDN.description_zh:
CA证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：组织机构所在国家代码。
O：组织机构的名称。
OU：组织机构下的部门。
L：组织机构所在城市。
CN：组织机构的通用名称或简称

Trial.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a trial instance. Valid values:

0: No.
1: Yes
Trial.description_zh:
是否为试用实例。取值：

0：表示否。
1：表示是

X509Certificate.description_en: The content of the CA certificate

Years.description_en: The validity period of the CA certificate. Unit: years

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page

PageCount.description_en: The total number of pages returned

ShowSize.description_en: The number of CA certificates per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of root CA certificates and subordinate CA certificates
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的根CA证书和子CA证书的总数量
